notes.title: Summer Update 2024
notes.content:
Pangolin Cassowary's final(?) update!

[b]New hidden area: The Bell Tower![/b] 
The Bell Tower is a new bonus room similar to the limited kick challenges on other levels. But finding this hidden bonus room may take some searching!

[b]Fixes! [/b]
I fixed some misplaced sound effects and other bugs like the checkpoints not working on some levels. 

[b]New controller feature! [/b]
Use the left and right bumpers to rotate Cassowary by 45 degrees! This should help with lining up some of those tricky kicks!

I had lots of ideas for how I wanted to add on or improve Pangolin Cassowary but making changes to the game became difficult without breaking the rest of the game. I'm instead going to focus those ideas toward a new game! So barring any hot fixes, this will be the game's final update.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 12
notes.content:
Hello!

Pangolin Cassowary still has a checkpoint bug on level 3 and a secret area. If you fall off the level and the checkpoint doesn't work. Try "Select" or "Tab" to reset to your last checkpoint.

Also congrats if you have reached the ground floor! That is in-fact the end of the game. 

- M
